episode_summary: In this episode, Vija Williams discusses the importance of cash offer seller leads in reaching potential clients before they contact other agents. She emphasizes the need for agents to adapt to changing consumer behaviors and leverage AI and technology to provide multiple solutions to clients. The episode offers actionable insights for agents and team leaders looking to enhance their lead generation strategies.
